subject: Re: Request to restore paused trial credits for ClearBay POC
messages:
From: Alex Morton <alex@clearbay.ai>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@clearbay.ai, claire@clearbay.ai
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trial credits expired — request for one-time extension to finish evaluation

Hi Sean,

We kicked off the ClearBay POC with Redwood last month and have built the integration into our ingestion pipeline. Unfortunately our evaluation stalled last week when the trial credits ran out — we hit a burst of long-context tests and burned through the sandbox.

Our product team still needs one final week to run a full end-to-end stress test (long sequences + routing). If possible, can Redwood provision a one-time top-up sufficient for ~250k tokens so we can complete the test? We can fast-track contract discussions if the results look good.

Background: we need this to validate latency/cost across the multi-model routing you suggested. If you need legal/procurement paperwork first, let me know; otherwise a temporary credit would unblock us.

Thanks — appreciate any help here.

— Alex Morton
Product Lead, ClearBay
Alex.Morton@clearbay.ai
(415) 555-0198
From: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
To: Alex Morton <alex@clearbay.ai>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trial credits expired — request for one-time extension to finish evaluation

Alex —

Thanks for the note and context. Sorry to hear you hit the limit at a critical point. We can support a short, one-time top-up to finish the stress run while legal/procurement iron out terms.

Quick ask from our side: can you confirm the tests will run no later than next Friday (3/26) and that the top-up will be used only for the POC outlined in your MAP doc? If yes, I can authorize a 250k-token sandbox credit today and loop in Ops to apply it.

Kimberly — can you confirm we have the authorization path for this (sandbox credit + quick audit note)? Jordan — flagging for deal continuity.

If Alex can shoot over a one-paragraph confirmation and an expected run window, I’ll move this through.

Regards,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Office: +1 650-555-0123
From: Claire Zhou <claire@clearbay.ai>

Cc: Alex Morton <alex@clearbay.ai>, procurement@clearbay.ai
Date: Thu, 19 Mar 2026 08:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trial credits expired — request for one-time extension to finish evaluation

Sean — thanks for the quick reply. Confirming:

• We will run the final stress/latency sweep between 3/22–3/25 and finish by 3/26.
• The tokens will be used only for the POC (end-to-end run + routing tests).
• Procurement is prepared to accept a short-term MAP (mutual action plan) and will sign once we validate the run.

We attached the MAP draft (ClearBay-MAP-draft.docx) and can provide any additional attestation you need. Please proceed with the 250k-token top-up.

Thanks — Claire
Claire Zhou
Engineering Manager, ClearBay
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trial credits expired — request for one-time extension to finish evaluation

All —

Authorized: I’ve applied a one-time sandbox credit equivalent to 250,000 tokens to the ClearBay POC environment (account id CB-9987). This credit will expire 2026-03-31 23:59 PT.

Operational notes:
- Audit: SOC2-redacted.pdf is attached for the standard security confirmation.
- Usage cap: The account has a temporary hard cap to ensure the credit is used for the POC run only; Ops will alert Sean and ClearBay if consumption exceeds 80% of the allocation.
- Billing: If ClearBay wants continuation beyond 3/31, we’ll need a signed MAP or an approved procurement PO. Jordan — please coordinate next steps for contracting.

Alex/Claire — good luck with the run. Please share any bandwidth metrics or an example prompt that pushes your routing; it’ll help us tune the deployment.

Kimberly Park
